title: Guides: mark up the pictures, hand a guide over to edit, pause on a click.
notes: Guides: mark up a step's picture. *Mark up picture* opens the step's screenshot in the image editor, with every tool there is: arrows, text, blur for anything private, crop. *Done* puts it back in the step, and the marks stay editable.
Shared guides pause on a click: click the picture to stop on a step and look, click again to carry on. (Its edges still go back and on.) Guides made before get this the next time they are saved.

Guides: export to edit. *Export › Editable guide* saves the whole guide as one .regaguide file, with its full-quality pictures and the marks on them. Whoever gets it double-clicks it: it opens in their Rega (which now opens .regaguide files, on Mac and Windows) to edit before it is published. *File › Open Guide…* (⇧⌘O), *Open image…* and dropping it on the window work too.
Guides: the step list follows a title as it is typed.
